narration: The Taj Mahal, standing on the banks of the Yamuna river in Agra, is one of the greatest monuments ever built for love.
Emperor Shah Jahan commissioned it in 1632 in memory of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died during childbirth.
Over twenty thousand artisans worked for more than two decades, crafting white marble inlaid with precious stones.
